Agentic OS for banking

Agentic risk and compliance for banks & credit unions

Book a demo

Agents do the groundwork of compliance. A named person on your team makes every decision.

  1. Today

    Compliance lives in many places.

    Six buildings with no roads between them. When a rule changes or a control breaks, someone carries the pieces from one to the next by hand.

  2. With Madison

    Plexus connects them.

    Plexus is the record underneath. It links each rule to its obligations, policies, controls, tests and evidence, so a change can be traced to everything it touches.

  3. With agents

    Agents do the work.

    Agents travel Plexus: they read the rule, draft each edit, test the control and file the evidence. A person approves every change.

Lyzr is trusted by

Trusted by Accenture, Crown Castle, WTW, Verifone, KPMG, AWS, Hitachi, Movate, Firstsource, MSP Corp, Persistent and AirAsia Move.

An interactive preview of the product, on an illustrative example. A Regulation E amendment changes provisional credit from 10 to 5 business days. Madison reads the rule and proposes its obligations, holding one back at the quality check; a compliance analyst accepts six and excludes one that is out of scope; Madison finds a gap and a drift; the head of payment operations updates the procedure and the policy from Madison's drafts; the third-party risk manager confirms three vendors meet the limit; the chief compliance officer accepts the impact and the change closes. Coverage moves to 1,723 covered and every step is on the audit trail.

Madison proposes. Your people decide.

The evidence · 8

  1. Decide whether an error occurred within 10 business days of the notice.

    12 CFR 1005.11(c)(1)Clear

    shall determine whether an error occurred within 10 business days of receiving a notice of error

  2. Provisionally credit the customer within 5 business days for card and ACH errors.

    12 CFR 1005.11(c)(2)Clear

    provisionally credits the consumer's account in the amount of the alleged error within 5 business days of receiving the error notice

  3. Tell the customer the amount and date of the provisional credit within 2 business days.

    12 CFR 1005.11(c)(2)(iv)Clear

    informs the consumer, within two business days after the provisional crediting, of the amount and date

  4. For new accounts and point-of-sale errors, finish within 20 business days and 90 days.

    12 CFR 1005.11(c)(3)Likely

    The time periods are extended to 20 business days and 90 days for new accounts and point-of-sale transactions

  5. Report the results to the customer within 3 business days of finishing.

    12 CFR 1005.11(d)(1)Clear

    shall report the results to the consumer within three business days after completing its investigation

  6. Correct a confirmed error within 1 business day.

    12 CFR 1005.11(e)Clear

    shall correct the error within one business day after determining that an error occurred

  7. Excluded (1)Prepaid accounts: provisional credit timing for unregistered accounts. Northgate does not offer prepaid accounts.
  8. Held back by the quality check (1)Notify within 1 business day of extension. The quoted sentence describes the consumer's notice, not a bank obligation with a 1 day deadline. Held back.

The evidence · 1

  1. 12 CFR 1005.11(c) · Provisional credit for card and ACH disputes

    Provisional credit for card and ACH error claims moves from 10 business days to 5 business days. Wire transfers are still outside Regulation E.

What's next

12 CFR 1005.11(c) is closed. The gap on provisional credit is closed, Marlow, Corvane and Vantrel meet 5 business days, and Anthony Marsh accepted the impact. 6 of 6 obligations are covered.

Drift · policy and procedure disagree

rule: 5 business days
POL-DISP-01 4.2Provisional credit

“Where an investigation is not completed within 10 business days, the account is provisionally credited for the disputed amount within 10 business days of the notice.”

PRC-DISP-06 step 4Apply provisional credit

“On day 7 after the notice, if the case is open, the analyst applies provisional credit and logs the case in the aging report.”

The policy says 10 business days and the procedure says day 7. Both are later than the new 5 business day limit.
